content.short: Business checking, payments, credit and cards.
content.description: Bluevine, founded in 2013, is a US small-business banking platform that combines a business checking account with payments, credit, and cards. Businesses use it to earn interest on checking balances, send and receive ACH and wire payments, pay bills, access lines of credit and term financing, and issue physical and virtual debit cards to their teams. With international payment support and integrations into accounting tools, Bluevine positions itself as a modern alternative to traditional business banks for freelancers, startups, and growing small companies. Its blend of accounts, credit, and bill pay generates ongoing transaction and reconciliation activity central to how small businesses run their finances.
content.meta: Bluevine offers small-business checking, payments, credit, and cards in the US. Discover Bluevine and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
